question.prompt: Which is the smallest of the four numbers \(-5, -1, 0, 3\)?

solutions.explanation: Negative numbers are less than \(0\), and \(0\) is less than positive numbers. Of two negative numbers, the one with the greater absolute value is smaller. Since \(|-5|>|-1|\), \(-5\) is the smallest.
solutions.title: Compare signs and absolute values
